component.name: vinoSearch
component.summary: Semantic file search for KDE and GNOME

description.p: Finds files by what is in them, from KRunner and GNOME Shell's search. The models run on an Intel NPU through OpenVINO, or on the GPU or CPU.

ul.li: The first release as a Flatpak bundle
Encrypt the index in the Flatpak, sealed by the host's TPM
The settings and search windows draw their own title bar
